mustAddress.title: Registered handoff contract remains canonical
mustAddress.catchCriteria: The plan keeps payload shape and normalization in `HandoffType.schema`, `HandoffType.preprocess`, and `HandoffType.validators` in `src/workflows/handoffs/registry.ts` while placing the execution size policy outside the registry.

mustAddress.title: Configuration ownership and threading
mustAddress.catchCriteria: The plan adds a validated non-negative size setting to `FlywheelConfigSchema` in `src/orchestration/config/schema.ts`, covers TOML loading in `tests/unit/orchestration/config/config.test.ts`, and threads the decoded value through `createWorkflowHost` in `src/orchestration/workflow-host-factory.ts` instead of reading configuration from workflows code.

mustAddress.title: Canonical byte measurement
mustAddress.catchCriteria: The plan measures UTF-8 bytes of the canonical `JSON.stringify` payload by reusing or matching `contentEvidence` in `src/infra/content-evidence.ts` and `buildHandoffWrittenFact` in `src/workflows/handoffs/handoff-facts.ts`, not JavaScript string length or a preview.

mustAddress.title: Model-facing writer rejection
mustAddress.catchCriteria: The plan enforces the ceiling in `createHandoffToolCore.execute` in `src/orchestration/agent-runtime/shared/handoff-tool.ts` after schema and mechanical validation but before `handoff.onContent`, returning a typed actionable error with actual and allowed byte counts and no truncated payload.

mustAddress.title: Worker to attempt failure path
mustAddress.catchCriteria: The plan traces size rejection through `capturedHandoff` in `src/orchestration/worker-callback.ts`, `createAttemptRunner` in `src/workflows/vm/attempt-runner.ts`, and `AttemptFailureSchema` in `src/workflows/vm/events.ts` so an oversized handoff becomes an explicit failed attempt rather than a missing handoff or storage failure.

mustAddress.title: Existing retry and pause semantics
mustAddress.catchCriteria: The plan integrates the typed size failure with `failAttempt` in `src/workflows/vm/attempt-transitions.ts`, preserving authored handoff retry limits and the final paused workflow behavior without adding a parallel attempt state.

mustAddress.title: Atomic handoff publication
mustAddress.catchCriteria: The plan updates `completionFacts` in `src/workflows/vm/companions.ts` and the `commitOrRehydrate` path in `src/workflows/vm/host-commit-controller.ts` so accepted handoffs still publish `handoff.written` and `handoff.validated` atomically while an oversized rejected payload publishes no `handoff.written` content and still commits its failed attempt outcome.

mustAddress.title: Strict fact and replay contract
mustAddress.catchCriteria: The plan preserves the strict evidence fields in `HandoffWrittenFactSchema` in `src/workflows/handoffs/handoff-events.ts` and strict replay through `reduceHandoffEvent` in `src/workflows/handoffs/handoff-projection.ts`, with no truncated or partial content fact.

mustAddress.title: Module boundary direction
mustAddress.catchCriteria: The plan respects the `workflows-imports-infra-only` rule in `scripts/check-boundaries.ts` by keeping configuration and runtime tool wiring in orchestration and never importing `src/orchestration/` from `src/workflows/`.

mustAddress.title: Boundary and durable tests
mustAddress.catchCriteria: The plan extends `tests/unit/orchestration/agent-runtime/tools/tools-handoff.test.ts`, `tests/unit/workflows/vm/companions.test.ts`, and `tests/integration/workflows/vm-commit-protocol.test.ts` for just-under, exact, over-limit, and multibyte payloads, no capture or written fact on rejection, explicit failed-attempt behavior, and unchanged atomic success facts.
